claim_scores.rationale: Defines `IntSig` and `StrSig` with the same field names and matching `InputField`/`OutputField` metadata; only `answer` changes from `int` to `str`.
Checks `output_fields['answer'].annotation` for both signatures with runtime `assert`s, confirming `int` versus `str`.
Asserts `IntSig.equals(StrSig) is True` and prints the result, directly proving type-only differences do not affect `Signature.equals`.
Provides no custom docstrings or instructions, so both signatures use the same default instructions derived from identical field names, isolating the annotation-only change.
